description: This file declares functions and data structures for managing WPA supplicant configurations, including loading, creating, deleting, writing, and modifying configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads WPA supplicant configuration from a specified file path.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_createConfig
methods.description: Creates a new, empty WPA supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_deleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes a given WPA supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the current WPA supplicant configuration to a specified file.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds a configuration parameter (key-value pair) to the WPA supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_delConfigParam
methods.description: Removes a configuration parameter identified by key from the configuration.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getGlobalConfig
methods.description: Retrieves global configuration parameters as a map.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getNetworkConfig
methods.description: Retrieves network-specific configuration parameters as a map.
